Check your internet connection and the server URL in Settings, then try again.

To get the news the moment it arrives — even with the screen locked — the app needs four permissions:

1) Notifications
2) Display over other apps
3) Ignore battery optimizations
4) Full screen intent (Android 14+)

You will find a button for each one in Settings.
Leave empty unless STREAM_TOKEN is set on the server
Critical news only (urgent / shelling / casualties / evacuation…)
Full screen when the device is locked
Full screen for every item (not only critical)
Keep watching for news in the background
Battery saver (up to ~2 min delay when the screen is off)
Without these you still get the notification, but the screen will not wake up while locked.
For Xiaomi / Huawei / Oppo / Vivo devices: in the system settings enable “Autostart” and set M-TRACKER to “Unrestricted”, otherwise the system will stop the service when the app is closed.
